claim.value: A reduced configuration may be retained for further partitioning only when repeated tests continue to reproduce the defined failure.
claim.scope: Acceptance and continuation rule for the iterative reduction search.

provenance.rationale: P013 states the retention and continuation rule; P004 identifies the defined failure.

signal_basis.value: A smaller configuration repeatedly reproduces lateness under fixed test conditions and the same predeclared repetition rule used for the baseline; uncertain or inconsistent outcomes remain unresolved.
signal_basis.scope: Tests of reductions of the selected case, with equipment, agreed start deadline and other test conditions held fixed.

provenance.rationale: These spans provide repeated reproduction in a smaller configuration, fixed test conditions, the common repetition rule and treatment of unresolved outcomes; P004 supplies the failure definition.
The claim is supported without an additional unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Repeated reproduction licenses retaining the reduced configuration as a failure-preserving candidate for further partitioning. The claim concerns this search rule alone and requires no inference to minimality, causal mechanism or field effectiveness.
uncertainty: No material warrant uncertainty under the stipulated prerequisites and observed signal.
